reviewer_role: Independent visual reviewer; not extractor; no delegation
method: Opened all 20 authoritative source PNG pages and all 57 individual crops. Inspected all four crop edges and required musical content at native crop resolution; enlarged ambiguous marks in 3.196. Independently compared decoded RGB pixels against source crops with Pillow ImageChops: 57/57 exact matches. Independently checked source_image, printed_page and 1-based pdf_page against sources/index.json: 57/57 match. No retouching, artificial margins, crop edits, manifest edits, text edits or tracker edits performed.
rect_convention: Source coordinates [left, top, right, bottom], right/bottom exclusive. proposed_rect is null unless a complete replacement has been cropped from the authoritative source and opened for visual testing.
caption_check: All manifest image filenames, example/exercise identities, captions and printed-page references agree with source. Verified text-257-276.md and text-257-276-review.json were read. The text candidate has visual placeholders rather than final Markdown image blocks: final alt text, embeds, captions and MuseScore placeholders remain integration checks, not claimed complete here.
source_limited_policy: RECROP_REQUIRED is a failed checklist decision, not permission to retouch. Source-limited handwriting overlaps notation or occupies the same rectangular envelope as required printed labels/clefs; no safe clean rectangle is proposed. A cleaner authoritative scan or an explicit policy decision is needed. Isolated non-letter scan specks alone are not treated as handwriting.
